findings.evidence: AGENTS.md defines wiki/ and mocs/ as canonical, while .wiki/config.md directs content into .wiki/raw and .wiki/wiki; .wiki/_index.md reports zero sources and articles.
findings.impact: Default Wiki resolution can target an empty scaffold and miss the populated repository wiki.

findings.evidence: The working tree has 807 untracked and 7 modified paths; only 1 raw path and 6 wiki/MOC paths are currently tracked.
findings.impact: Most ingested knowledge lacks committed history and can be lost or omitted from review.

findings.evidence: All 389 raw-source provenance notes omit licensing or permission status; 71 also lack an external origin URL.
findings.impact: Source reuse and redistribution rights cannot be assessed from the wiki.

findings.evidence: Seven Chinese source notes and four Chinese synthesis pages derive only from English sources.
findings.impact: The content is readable and supported but violates the repository language rule.

findings.evidence: Seven external PBL source notes preserve URLs and summaries but no immutable local source capture.
findings.impact: The research chain is currently verifiable but cannot be fully replayed if publisher pages change or disappear.

findings.evidence: Six synthesis pages cite raw/docs/ as a directory rather than enumerating the source records supporting individual claims.
findings.impact: Broad conclusions are plausible but expensive to reproduce at claim level.

findings.evidence: Five pages contain four distinct issues: one PBL workload conflict, three competition-format flags.
findings.impact: Two flags can be weakened with official evidence; two remain unresolved pending source clarification.

findings.evidence: No topic-local session event log or checkpoint existed before this audit; only coarse wiki log entries and an external redacted session digest were available.
findings.impact: Past ingest and research actions cannot be replayed in detail.

findings.evidence: No project .gitignore was found while .DS_Store, Obsidian state, and Wiki scaffolding are untracked.
findings.impact: Review noise increases and local operational files may be committed accidentally.

investigations.reason: The same provider document states both at least two hours and one-to-two hours; no independent authoritative schedule was found.

investigations.claim: Sir Isaac Newton Exam is offline versus online
investigations.reason: Waterloo states that the test is delivered online but must be written under local in-person supervision.

investigations.claim: International Economics Olympiad is offline versus online
investigations.reason: Official rules say MainTrack is normally on-site while OpenTrack and exceptional editions may be online.

investigations.claim: Intermediate and Senior Physics Challenge is offline versus online
investigations.reason: Available evidence distinguishes standard and Online variants, but the primary BPhO site returned HTTP 403 during audit.

investigations.claim: General PBL synthesis accurately represents its cited research
investigations.reason: Live publisher and framework pages support the stated design elements, positive-but-uncertain evidence direction, and methodological cautions.

outputs.note: .wiki/output contains only its empty index; no deliverable artifacts exist.

security.note: Two apparent 18-digit ID matches were inspected and were URL identifiers; two wiki matches were substrings of content hashes.

provenance.historical_limit: Past operations have coarse log entries but no fine-grained topic-local event history.
